First, I need to check the statement: "the toronto blue jays played in 8 games with an attendance greater than 5000 in may of the 1991 season."  

Looking at the table, all games are in May (dates from May 1 to May 31). The attendance column shows numbers like 33439, 22896, etc. All of these are clearly greater than 5000.  

Let me count the rows:  
From May 1 to May 31, there are 27 rows (27 games).  
Every attendance value is over 5000 (lowest is 20809).  

So the number of games with attendance > 5000 is 27, not 8.  

The statement says 8 games, which is false.  

Final Answer: No
